messages.content: Picking a cost optimisation pass back up.
OK, back on a cost optimisation pass.
Happy to dig into this more. We landed on provider versions pinned to a minor range.
Where did we land on a cost optimisation pass?
Turned out terraform/vpc.tf was the culprit file. Happy to dig into this more. Turned out terraform/variables.tf was the culprit file.
Personally AWS as the single cloud provider feels right to me.

The dashboards lit up because of a destroy plan on the production database from a renamed resource. Between the options, separate accounts for production and staging came out ahead. Good call, switching.
I'd like to get removing the last hardcoded account IDs in before Friday.
That leaves VPC flow logs shipped to the log bucket behind us. A disaster recovery restore rehearsal keeps slipping. One state file per environment is the clear winner here.
All things considered, Checkov for policy scanning wins. That leaves CloudWatch alarms on the error rate metric behind us. No regressions so far.
Turned out terraform/iam.tf was the culprit file. .github/workflows/plan.yml got a few more lines. Terraform over CloudFormation is the clear winner here. Nothing failed on the last run.

Here's what I found. Most of the afternoon went into modules/service/main.tf. Most of the afternoon went into environments/prod/terragrunt.hcl. After a couple of tries, an RDS instance with automated backups finally works.
